caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object resembles a rectangular, three-dimensional container or case with a marbled, tan and light brown surface. The left side of the object is rounded and bound with two dark brown cords, and there is a small, dark motif resembling an animal, placed vertically near the left binding. The main face of the object displays a geometrical, symmetrical, and colorful design composed of rectangles, zigzag lines, and thin elongated shapes. The design is bordered in a dark green color, with individual sections in red, yellow, pink, black, and brown. The top left and bottom right corners of the rectangle have horizontal lines, while the central area contains two vertical rectangles filled with zigzag patterns in black, red, and white. There are three peripheral rectangular extensions full of parallel lines: two yellow and one red. The composition of the object suggests a handmade item with decorative elements. The artist's name, "R. F. Fuller," is inscribed in small brown letters on the lower right side of the object.
title: Book Cover
